entries.zh: 属于；归属；所及（如房产之归属）
entries.en: to belong (to); to pertain (to); to appertain

entries.zh: 属于本人；切身之事；本分
entries.en: to pertain to oneself; one's own affair; what concerns oneself
obstinate; stubbornly clinging (to one's own view)
obstinately holding to one view; rigidly single-minded

entries.zh: 死心眼；固执不通（如打死结，喻不可解）
entries.en: obstinate; stubborn (lit. to tie a dead knot that cannot be untied)

entries.zh: 困守；储备军械以坚守（守城）
entries.en: to provision oneself (with munitions) and hold out; to stand a siege
entries.notes: 西语栏「pertrechasse loscria / 2oſ」残损难读，义据 H 困守与 pertrecharse（备械自守）推定。

entries.en: to disturb; to unsettle; to perturb
entries.notes: 汉字「撓数」罕见（疑为「擾數」之讹），西语栏缩写「g. in quietar」＝generalmente inquietar，义据西语推定。

entries.en: to pervert (reason); to violate what is right; to deceive
the sliding weight (poise) of a steelyard
entries.notes: 汉字「鏈」与音写 Jûy 不合（疑当作「錘」），义据 pesa de la romana 定为秤砣。
「駝」为「砣」的同音借写，tō 即秤砣。

entries.en: weights (of a balance); a set of balance weights
entries.notes: 「駝馬」为「砣碼」的同音借写，tô-bê 指成套砝码。
汉字「天平」指衡器本体，与西语 pesa（砝码、秤砣）略有出入，仍属同一量衡语义场。

entries.zh: 杆秤的秤砣（秤锤）；原件污损，音写不全
entries.en: the weight (poise) of a steelyard; text damaged and partly unreadable
entries.notes: 音写三音节与两字汉字不符，且一处声调符号污损（T99），仅据西语 pesa de la romana 与「鏈」字定名。
汉字「狂眠」与音写 puè-bīn／cuê-bīn 不相合，义据西语 pesadilla 定为梦魇。
